name: Review shape geometry
description: Lets the user correct proposed shape geometry at the complete-union or individual-piece level without overwriting automatic detection.

fields.name: selected_shape
fields.description: References the active automatic or manually adjusted shape proposal shown on the canvas.

fields.name: editing_level
fields.description: Chooses whether handles and numeric controls transform the complete shape union or one additive piece.

options.name: Complete shape
options.description: Moves or scales the full primitive or composite union.

options.name: Individual piece
options.description: Edits one rectangle within an additive composite.

fields.name: bounds
fields.description: Stores exact image-space x, y, width, and height for the selected shape or additive piece.

fields.name: primitive_type
fields.description: Changes the selected proposal among rectangle, rounded rectangle, circle, ellipse, composite, or irregular mask when automatic classification is wrong.

options.name: Rounded rectangle
options.description: Uses a rectangle with editable outer corner radii.

options.name: Composite
options.description: Uses a union of editable additive rectangles.

options.name: Irregular mask
options.description: Preserves the detected raster mask without forcing a primitive.

fields.name: corner_radii
fields.description: Stores independently editable top-left, top-right, bottom-right, and bottom-left outer radii.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Records whether the proposal needs review, is accepted, or is rejected as a false positive.

options.name: Accepted
options.description: Marks the geometry ready for shape-layer creation.

options.name: Rejected
options.description: Hides the false-positive proposal while keeping it recoverable.

actions.name: Add piece
actions.description: Adds an editable rectangle to the selected composite proposal.

actions.name: Remove piece
actions.description: Removes the selected additive rectangle while preserving proposal history.

actions.name: Merge regions
actions.description: Creates a new composite proposal from selected regions.

actions.name: Split region
actions.description: Creates separate proposals from a user-defined division of one region.

actions.name: Restore proposal
actions.description: Restores a rejected or previously superseded proposal as a new version.

output.name: manual_shape_proposal
output.description: Stores corrected geometry separately from the immutable detector mask and automatic fit.
